node.label: Decreased CSF asialotransferrin to transferrin ratio
node.definition: The concentration of asialotransferrin relative to that of transferrin in the cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) is below the lower limit of normal.

evidence.snippet: Leukoencephalopathy with vanishing white matter 5, with or without ovarian failure: Decreased CSF asialotransferrin to transferrin ratio (frequency 7/7) [PCS]
